admission.justification: Rule 7 removes navigation code; without rule 10 a later change could rebuild a parallel route to a chat 'for convenience' and recreate the duplication the developer rejected. The rule is a member of the host-list navigation family.

applicability: Every dashboard surface that could link to a certain agent's chat or build navigation of its own.
conditions: The launcher's execution steering (show the displayed execution's agent) keeps working.
The retained PaseoFrameControl steers the displayed execution through its current trusted message/URL owner; no new sidebar, list or navigation command is added.
exclusions: The old L75 highlight-composer preservation exception is superseded by the explicit R113 removal, not permission to restore a dormant composer.
No claim that a deleted AR selection/highlight submit path survives; host chat content remains host-owned.
statement: No new dashboard chat navigation is added; existing host execution steering remains, while R113 removes the AR highlight composer and its old switch-to-Chats transition rather than creating a replacement route.
